decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY establishing one commission per primary mint, inclusion of random no-referral allocations, and exclusion of secondary-market sales.
The reconciliation rule for aggregate visible ticket totals does not change the existing NFT metadata identity, counter-presence, badge, or ebook-reference requirements.
Excluding secondary sales from ticket generation does not change the public countdown measuring sales remaining until the prize draw.
The ticket and commission reconciliation rule does not alter how successfully minted NFT ownership must be represented in the dashboard inventory.
Random no-referral commission and ticket allocations do not constitute referrals, so the source decision does not change referral-count visibility.
The source changes expected ticket and commission accounting, not the amount displayed for the funded prize pool.
The existing rule that public mint statistics count successfully completed mints remains valid and unchanged.
Ticket and commission registration has no necessary effect on NFT image or media rendering behavior.
The source concerns commissions and tickets generated by all primary mints; randomly allocated no-referral rewards do not change recorded referral activity.
The source excludes secondary sales from generating tickets and commissions but does not change their established role in funding the pool or counting toward the draw cadence.
The current FAQ already describes random allocation for no-referral mints and does not state that secondary sales generate new tickets; the reconciliation rule requires no necessary content change.
The source necessarily establishes that every primary mint generates one ticket, including a randomly allocated ticket when no referral code is used, while secondary-market sales generate none.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: The number of commissions and tickets should equal the number of mints, excluding secondary market sales, but those issued at random do not appear to be registering.

value_updates.ticket_count_reconciliation_rule: One Small Block ticket is generated for every primary mint; secondary-market sales generate no new ticket.
value_updates.no_referral_mint_ticket_allocation: When a primary mint has no referral code, its ticket is issued at random to an existing NFT holder.
